notes.title: About our BETA v0.6 Patch Notes and Update
notes.notes:
Good Day Good Knights!

Back in the fall, we announced the launch date for [b]King Arthur: Legends Rise[/b] would be delayed. We said that we were committed to putting in the work to make this game great, something we meant then and that we absolutely mean now. We promised that big changes were coming to get us there, and while a few of those changes arrived in our v0.5 update, v0.6 is where the bulk of those changes landed. So much so that it has grown beyond our best initial estimations. Simply put, we are not satisfied with where we landed and have therefore made the determination that we will need some additional time to address it.  As a result our patch notes, which have grown equally large, will be held back until the update details are finalized. We hope to soon share more about what you can expect to see in our update, but in the meantime, we hope you’ll continue to enjoy the game, and rack up those extra rewards prior to the Progression Reboot coming with v0.6.

Stay tuned for more information
-Kabam Pinwheel

notes.title: PROGRESSION REBOOT ANNOUNCEMENT
notes.notes:
[h1]PROGRESSION REBOOT ANNOUNCEMENT[/h1]

Good Day Good Knights!

On this day, we have two announcements for you of the utmost importance! 
First, our next update (v0.6) is tentatively set for a [i][b]March 5th 2024[/b][/i] release!
Keep an eye out for our Patch Notes on [i][b]February 27th[/b][/i] (and maybe even a few extra goodies in the coming weeks)!

Second, this update contains a substantial rework to our early game progression and how new players experience the game, such as when and how content and buildings unlock. To avoid any unforeseen issues or knock-on effects, we want to ensure that everyone goes through this new early game progression flow.  The good news is

[h2]This will NOT require a full on reset and wipe of all data.[/h2]

So what does this mean for you?
First and foremost, all of your in-game collections including Heroes, equipment, inventories, currency, items and resources will remain just as it was prior to the update. 

What [b]will [/b]happen is a [i][b]PROGRESSION Reboot[/b][/i]. 

So while your heroes and inventories remain the same, your story, adventure, and Camelot progress will be rewound to the beginning. To be clear, this does not include any progress you have made with regard to Hero/Relic/Equipment levels, skills, and advancement. So while you will need to replay story and adventure content, you will once again be able to collect all of the one-time rewards for these game modes using the full might of your current roster! And yes, this means once again collecting star rewards, Royal Road, Achievements, and Chronicle!

Further, we know that you have all put time into getting to where you are in [b]King Arthur: Legends Rise[/b], and while we certainly hope it was a fun journey, we know it wasn’t a short one, so we prepared compensation packages based on 3 tiers of in-game progress. One part in particular to take note of is making sure you have some Iron and Wood to help kick start rebuilding Camelot for our 2nd and 3rd tiers.
For a more detailed look at the compensation coming your way, please see the accompanying image.

While we have some time before this new update, we recommend halting any updates to Camelot buildings until version 0.6 is released as your current Iron and Wood balances will remain through to the next update, any upgrades made before then will be rewound with the rest of your story progression.

We know this is a sweeping change among the others coming with v0.6 but always remember, these changes are largely in part due to the amazing feedback you all have provided and continue to provide. We very much appreciate it and please know that it has had a substantial impact on our games development. We look forward to a lot more of it with this update, so keep that feedback coming. Send it with a swallow if need be!

That wraps it up for this announcement.  Stay tuned for more information coming about v0.6, we can’t wait to share more with you!
